items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: one of the photos he showed me was one from 52nd Street with Coleman Hawkins, Don Bias, Benny Harris, Thelonious Monk, Al Hall and himself.

ctx.x: Yeah, it's right there hanging in my archives.

I'll have to look at that. We were just looking at some more pictures from Cozy's archives, and one of the photos he showed me was one from 52nd Street with Coleman Hawkins, Don Bias, Benny Harris, Thelonious Monk, Al Hall and himself. That's a pretty famous photo. I've seen that in books.
